items.title: Error in gradient calculation in flow past an obstacle
items.body:
I wanted to calculate the gradient in a flow past a cylinder problem, but I got the following error. It seems something is wrong under the hood.

```python from phi.torch.flow import * device = torch.device('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu') print(device) N = 32 # grid resolution x_min = -5.0 # min X coordinate x_max = 15.0 # max X coordinate y_min = -5.0 # min Y coordinate y_max = 5.0 # max Y coordinate dt = 0.1 # time step nu = 0.1 # kinematic viscosity # Define domain and settings domain = Box(x=(x_min,x_max), y=(y_min,y_max)) # cylinder = Sphere(x=0, y=0, radius=0.5) cylinder = Box(x=(-0.5,0.5), y=(-0.5,0.5)) # Plot the obstacle and inflow regions _=plot(domain, cylinder, overlay='args') #@jit_compile def forward_run(forcing, v0, dt=dt, vis=nu): v = v0 for i in range(2): v = advect.semi_lagrangian(v, v, dt) v = diffuse.explicit(v, vis, dt) v = v + forcing * dt v,_ = fluid.make_incompressible(v,cylinder, Solve('scipy-direct')) loss = field.l2_loss(v-field.stop_gradient(v0)) return loss boundary = {'x-': vec(x=1.0,y=0.0), 'x+': ZERO_GRADIENT, 'y': PERIODIC} v0 = StaggeredGrid(vec(x=1.0,y=0.0), boundary=boundary, bounds=domain,x=N*2,y=N) v0, _ = fluid.make_incompressible(v0, cylinder, Solve('scipy-direct')) _=plot(v0) boundary = {'x-': 0, 'x+': ZERO_GRADIENT, 'y': PERIODIC} forcing = StaggeredGrid(0, boundary=boundary, bounds=domain,x=N*2,y=N) forward_run(forcing,v0) sim_grad = field.gradient(forward_run,wrt='forcing',get_output=False) forcing_grad = sim_grad(forcing,v0) _=plot(forcing_grad)
